PewterCity_House3_Text_Boy.en: I'm going to be a GYM LEADER\none day!\pLEADER KAY says I need a strong\nFIRE POKéMON first.
PewterCity_House3_Text_Boy.fr: Je serai CHAMPION un jour !\pLa CHAMPIONNE KAY dit que j'ai\nd'abord besoin d'un POKéMON FEU\lfort.

PewterCity_House3_Text_Mother.en: My boy trains at the GYM every\nday.\pHe always comes home smelling of\nsmoke and sulfur.
PewterCity_House3_Text_Mother.fr: Mon garçon s'entraîne à l'ARÈNE\nchaque jour.\pIl rentre toujours en sentant la\nfumée et le soufre.

PewterCity_House3_Text_MotherAsk.en: My son's POKéMON fainted deep in\nthe forest and he cried all\lnight.\pA REVIVE would mean the world.
PewterCity_House3_Text_MotherAsk.fr: Le POKéMON de mon fils s'est\névanoui au fond de la forêt et il a\lpleuré toute la nuit.\pUn RAPPEL signifierait le monde\npour lui.

PewterCity_House3_Text_MotherGives.en: You are an angel! He's smiling\nagain!\pThis was my husband's. A trainer\nshould carry it.
PewterCity_House3_Text_MotherGives.fr: T'es un ange ! Il sourit de\nnouveau !\pC'était à mon mari. Un dresseur\ndevrait le porter.

PewterCity_House3_Text_MotherNo.en: I understand. Please be safe out\nthere.

PewterCity_House3_Text_MotherOffer.en: A REVIVE! Would you really give\nit to my son?
PewterCity_House3_Text_MotherOffer.fr: Un RAPPEL ! Tu le donnerais\nvraiment à mon fils ?
